evidence.description: Two removed wooden fastener-like pieces are shown by hand and side by side. One is distinctly longer; both have a bent/curved shaft and enlarged head.
Reported workshop explanation: possibly two per Kumpf, one long and one short, potentially used to establish or secure twist/inclination.
ThorstenHalsch confirms two Kumpfnägel, one long and one short, and explains unequal lengths by overlap of neighboring Kümpfe.

candidates.statement: Each Kumpf uses a paired long and short wooden securing pin.
candidates.assessment: Promote pair existence and long/short distinction into baseline; exact all-vessel scope remains to verify.

candidates.statement: The length/curvature difference contributes to Kumpf inclination or twist.
candidates.assessment: Expert explanation attributes length difference to neighboring-vessel overlap, not primarily tilt/twist.

candidates.statement: The Kumpfnägel fasten the Kumpf through drilled staves to the Krümmling; exact structural load path and geometry remain open.
Long/short pairs vary by repair history rather than being a canonical pair.
candidates.assessment: Repair-only explanation no longer primary because a systematic construction reason was provided.

candidates.statement: The long/short length difference accommodates directed overlap of neighboring Kümpfe around the circumference.
candidates.assessment: New primary functional explanation; exact overlap direction and nail paths remain geometric verification tasks.

saturday_acceptance: Photograph long and short pin together while still installed on at least three Kumpf assemblies.
Record orientation, head side, insertion direction and neighboring paddle/rim reference.
Keep each removed pair physically associated with its Kumpf ID.
Measure total length, section, bend/offset and head geometry of each removed pin.
Photograph empty seats/holes immediately after removal.
Measure Kumpf inclination before removal and compare against long/short pair orientation.
Ask experienced craftsperson what local term is correct and what functional difference long vs short has.
promotion_rule: Pair existence, terminology, attachment function and overlap-based length rationale are promoted as local expert baseline for the photographed reference construction. Exact nail paths, dimensions, installed orientation and all-vessel equivalence still require current photo/measurement/scan evidence.
